bug_semantics: MongoDB datasource queries interpolate end-user handlebars parameters into the builder JSON body, JSON.parse the result, and pass it to collection.find/update/delete with no $ operator filtering. With noEscaping, {{name}} inside {"name":"{{name}}"} is rendered as a raw triple-stache, so a BASIC user can break the JSON string (duplicate-key / $comment) and inject operators ($ne, $where, $lookup, etc.), collapsing per-user filters. SQL goes through interpolateSQL bind variables; MongoDB did not.
